# Prayer Lock

> Prayer Lock is an affordable mobile app (paid subscription) that blocks distracting apps on your phone until you pray. It helps people build a daily prayer habit, track a prayer streak, and reduce screen time by putting prayer before scrolling. Available now on iPhone (App Store); Android is in development.

## What Prayer Lock does

- **Blocks your phone until you pray.** You choose which apps to block (social media, news, games). They stay locked until you complete your prayer time, then unlock.
- **Daily prayer streak.** Tracks consecutive days of prayer to keep you consistent.
- **Reduces screen time.** Gating your most-used apps behind prayer naturally cuts doomscrolling.
- **Prayer history & mood tracking.** Review past prayer sessions and how you felt over time.

## Key facts

- Price: Paid subscription, priced to be more affordable than most prayer apps
- Platform: iOS (iPhone) — live. Android — in development (waitlist).
- Audience: Christians and anyone who wants to make prayer a daily priority before reaching for their phone.
- Privacy: Prayer Lock does not read the content of your prayers.
- Website: https://prayer-lock.com/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ro/app/prayer-lock-quiet-time/id6758918601

## Comparisons

Most prayer apps are content apps (guided prayers, meditations, Bible audio, reminders). Prayer Lock is different — it blocks your distracting apps until you actually pray. Honest comparisons:

- [Prayer Lock vs Hallow](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/hallow/)
- [Prayer Lock vs Pray.com](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/pray-com/)
- [Prayer Lock vs Abide](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/abide/)
- [Prayer Lock vs Echo Prayer](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/echo-prayer/)
- [Prayer Lock vs "Prayer Lock: Christian Focus"](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/prayer-lock-christian-focus/): two different apps with the same name, explained.
- [All comparisons](https://prayer-lock.com/compare/)
